title: Anthropic places further $11B TPU rack order with Broadcom

sources.quote: Anthropic has since placed an additional order valued at $11 billion that Tan said is scheduled for delivery later next year.

explain: After its first $10B order, Anthropic ordered another $11B of Google TPU-based server racks from Broadcom for delivery in late 2026, as disclosed by Broadcom's CEO on the December 2025 earnings call.
